violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Door handle needed for Reach-in-freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface Microwave was not cleaned as frequently as required.--Nonfood contact surface Door to Reach-in-Freezer was not cleaned as frequently as required. Reach-in-freezer needs defrosted.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Door seals found torn/damaged on refrigerator and freezer inside prep kitchen.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Multiple boxes found stored directly on floor.
Toilet facilities. — ---Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.
Clean, maintained, tissue, vented, self-closing door (1 pt deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
